options.name: schema
options.description: JSON Schema subset (root type object); unsupported keywords throw a configuration error listing each pointer.

options.name: uiSchema
options.description: Presentation: widget, label, help, placeholder, order, columns, span, visibleIf, rows, orientation, disableNonWorking, addLabel, patternMessage; children under fields, array items under items.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial value; values that do not match the schema type are ignored. reset() returns to it.

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the form. Default: the schema title.

options.name: submitLabel
options.description: Submit button text. Default: localized Submit.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable every field and the actions.

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Working days and holidays for the date pickers; disableNonWorking in the UI schema uses it.

options.name: timezone
options.description: IANA time zone of date-time fields. Default: the global configuration.

options.name: validate
options.description: Async validation after the constraint checks pass; return messages by JSON Pointer.

options.name: showActions
options.description: Show the submit (and optional reset) buttons.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages and of the rendered controls.

properties.name: form
properties.description: The Form instance (validation, Error Summary, submission, state events).

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: The current value as JSON; hidden and empty optional fields are left out.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validate visible fields and array sizes and show messages (no async validation).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear messages.

methods.name: setErrors
methods.description: Show errors by JSON Pointer on fields, groups, or the summary.

methods.name: focusField
methods.description: Move focus to the field at a pointer; false when it is not visible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge options and re-render, keeping the current value unless value is given.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroy every control and the Form and empty the host.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Any edit, including array add, remove, and move: { value, pointer }. Control events do not leave the form.

events.name: aui-invalid
events.description: Submission blocked: { errors: [{ pointer, label, message }] }.

cssClasses.name: aui-schema-form__grid | __grid--columns
cssClasses.description: Fields of an object; with columns from the UI schema.

cssClasses.name: aui-schema-form__cell | __cell--span
cssClasses.description: Wrapper of one field; spanning several columns.

cssClasses.name: aui-schema-form__items | __item | __tools
cssClasses.description: Entry list, one entry, and its move and remove buttons.

cssClasses.name: aui-schema-form__empty | __add
cssClasses.description: Empty-array text and the add button.
